<module id="traffic_light">
	<description>A simple traffic light system with a pedestrian crossing request.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="pass_request">A pedestrian crossing request.</input>
		
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		
		<output id="red">Red light signal.</output>
		<output id="yellow">Yellow light signal.</output>
		<output id="green">Green light signal.</output>
	end
	
	<parameter_description>
		idle = 2'd0;
		s1_red = 2'd1;
		s2_yellow = 2'd2;
		s3_green = 2'd3;
	end
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg [1:0] state;
		reg [1:0] n_state;
		
		reg [7:0] cnt;
		wire [7:0] cnt_next;
		
		reg p_red, p_yellow, p_green;
	end
	
	<implementation>
		assign cnt_next = cnt > 8'h0 ? cnt - 8'h1 : 8'h0;
		always @(*) begin
			case(state)
				idle: n_state <= s1_red;
				s1_red: n_state <= (cnt == 8'h3 || pass_request && p_green)? s3_green : s1_red;
				s2_yellow: n_state <= (cnt == 8'h3)? s1_red : s2_yellow;
				s3_green: n_state <= (cnt == 8'h3)? s2_yellow : s3_green;
			endcase
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n) begin
				cnt <= 8'd10;
				state <= idle;
				
				p_red <= 1'b0;
				p_yellow <= 1'b0;
				p_green <= 1'b0;
			end else begin
				cnt <= cnt_next;
				state <= n_state;
				
				p_red <= (state != s1_red);
				p_yellow <= (state != s2_yellow);
				p_green</implementation></logic_description></parameter_description></ports></module>
